support_claim: Commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, the MSA-HELION-2019 contract names Helion Robotics Ltd as counterparty, and billing records bill Helion Robotics Limited.
justification: Under the identity contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet provides establishing evidence—not mere name compatibility—that links both referents to one legal counterparty: the contract header identifies MSA-HELION-2019's counterparty as Helion Robotics Ltd, invoices identify the billed party as Helion Robotics Limited, and commercial notes affirm those names denote the same legal entity.
